tools.name: backup
tools.description:
Back up the entire database to a file. Creates a consistent snapshot of all
tables, indexes, triggers, and views at the destination path. The backup
runs incrementally in pages so it does not block other operations for long.

params.name: destination
params.description: The file path to write the backup to

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: create_fts_index
tools.description:
Create a full-text search index on an existing table using SQLite's FTS5
module. Specify the source table and the columns to index. The virtual table
is named `{table}_fts` by default and can be queried with the MATCH
operator.

params.name: fts_table_name
params.description: Optional name for the FTS virtual table (defaults to {table}_fts)

params.name: table_name
params.description: The source table to create an FTS index over

unsupported.name: columns
unsupported.reason: it is a list, which RigorRun cannot compare against yet

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: database_info
tools.description:
Return metadata about the database: SQLite version, page size, page count,
journal mode, WAL checkpoint status, total size in bytes, freelist (unused)
page count, and the number of tables and indexes. Useful for monitoring
database health and understanding storage characteristics.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description:
Describe the columns of a table. Returns each column's name, type, whether
it is NOT NULL, its default value, and whether it is part of the primary
key. Useful for inspecting a table's schema before writing queries.

params.name: table_name
params.description: The name of the table to describe

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: execute
tools.description:
Marker type for the `execute` tool. Implements `SqliteServerTool` to wire up
the tool's schema, handler, and routing. Stateless — all context comes from
`McpServerSqlite`.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description:
Show the query execution plan for a SQL statement. Returns the EXPLAIN QUERY
PLAN output showing how SQLite will scan tables, use indexes, and join data.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: list_foreign_keys
tools.description:
List all foreign key constraints for a given table. Returns one entry per
column mapping, including the referenced table, the local and remote
columns, and the ON UPDATE / ON DELETE actions. Composite foreign keys
produce multiple entries that share the same id.

params.name: table_name
params.description: The name of the table to list foreign keys for

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: list_indexes
tools.description:
List indexes in the database. When a table name is provided, only indexes
belonging to that table are returned. Otherwise all indexes across every
table are listed. Each index entry includes its name, the table it belongs
to, whether it enforces uniqueness, the ordered list of indexed columns, and
the WHERE predicate for partial indexes.

params.name: table_name
params.description: Filter indexes to this table. Omit for all tables.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description:
List all tables in the database with their names and CREATE TABLE schemas.
Returns an empty list if no tables exist. Useful for discovering the
database structure before writing queries.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: list_triggers
tools.description:
List all triggers in the database, or only those for a given table. Returns
each trigger's name, table, event, timing, and full SQL. Useful for
understanding data-change side effects before issuing write queries.

params.name: table_name
params.description: Optional table name to filter triggers by. Omit to list all triggers.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: List all views in the database with their names and defining SQL statements.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: search_fts
tools.description:
Search a full-text search index using SQLite's FTS5 MATCH syntax. Returns
results ranked by BM25 relevance with highlighted snippets showing where the
query matched. The FTS table must have been created previously (e.g. via
`create_fts_index`).

params.name: fts_table
params.description: The FTS5 virtual table to search

params.name: highlight_end
params.description: String after matched terms in snippets (default )

params.name: highlight_start
params.description: String before matched terms in snippets (default <b>)

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.

tools.name: vacuum
tools.description:
Reclaim unused space and defragment the database file by running SQLite's
VACUUM command. This rebuilds the entire database into a compact, contiguous
file. The operation may take a while on large databases.

risk.rationale: The server published no hint. Treated as writing until shown otherwise.
